rv.q: The point gets buried under excess.
WOMEN BEWARE WOMEN presented several problems for me, but these did not override its contributions: a stellar cast giving amazing performances and a wonderful production team.
However, with everything else that happens on stage, it's hard to celebrate the production's wins.
They have brought it to our time and yet, have also reverted back to the time when written.

cn.t: An ambitious but overlong debut from Blue in the Right Way tackles a 400-year-old play with bold, quirky staging and feminist updates, though the nearly three-hour production proves challenging to absorb.
